name: Oasis Securities Limited
about: Oasis Securities Limited operates as non-banking financial services as a Non-Systemically Important Non-Deposit Taking Company (NBFC-ND) in India. The company is primarily engaged in lending and investment activities, including offering term loans, financing solutions, and investment management services. The company was formerly known as Abhishek India Limited and changed its name to Oasis Securities Limited in February 1995. Oasis Securities Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Jaipur, India.
